relay.transcript.tool_row.bridge.outcome.note: Trailing amber word on a Team Bridge tool row whose message landed only in a peer's inbox, NOT in a conversation anyone reads. Must never read as success. Lower-case, no full stop; mirrors the relay key of the same name.
Trailing red word when Team Bridge refused the action. {code} is the relay's machine code (e.g. not_a_member) and stays untranslated. Keep the middle dot separator.
Trailing red word when the Team Bridge action failed. {code} is the relay's machine code and stays untranslated. Keep the middle dot separator.
Muted trailing words: the relay could not confirm the bridge post landed. Not a failure and not a success; do not imply either.
Muted trailing words: the target has not yet accepted the bridge invitation/conversation, so nothing is visible to them yet.

relay.transcript.tool_row.bridge.label_c.note: Field label in the expanded bridge row, before the conversation's name or kind word.

relay.transcript.tool_row.bridge.label_o.note: Field label in the expanded bridge row, before the outcome words.

relay.transcript.tool_row.bridge.kind_co.note: Stand-in for an unnamed Team Bridge channel conversation, after the 'Conversation' label. Indefinite, lower-case.

relay.transcript.tool_row.bridge.kind_dm.note: Stand-in for an unnamed direct-message conversation, after the 'Conversation' label. Indefinite, lower-case.

relay.transcript.tool_row.bridge.kind_te.note: Stand-in for an unnamed person target (a teammate), after the 'Conversation' label. Indefinite, lower-case.
